question:
A journey is made one afternoon at constant speed. The clocks show the departure and arrival times.
<image1>
In which position will the minute hand be when one third of the journey has been completed?
<image2>
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E

reason_zh: 删掉了原文“one afternoon”的时间范围。时钟只显示12小时制读数，该条件约束出发与到达属于同一下午，不能与朋友、姓名等无关背景一起删除。已查看图示；建议恢复该时间范围，并保留匀速、出发到达时钟及三分之一路程条件。
preserved_conditions: 路程三分之一时分针位置
